findings.finding: No complete multi-sport and station-specific coverage certificate exists in the repository. Absence from a feed is not proof of no game.
Inherited 2027 dates and TBD flags require fresh official review; inherited 2028–29 calendar blocks are scenarios, not released fixtures.
Network affiliation alone does not establish that a specific station will carry a specific event. Local blackouts and programming conflicts must be checked.
The inherited event grid is not evidence of exhaustive future coverage or local carriage. Other sports remain high-priority candidates, not confirmed local broadcasts.
Game lengths and overrun buffers are planning estimates. Regulation clocks and halftime rules do not establish real broadcast duration; future exact free minutes are unknown.
Future opponents, dates and kickoff times require field-by-field source review. Conflicting inherited dates are not silently reconciled.
An incomplete school schedule cannot certify that omitted days are free.
Every MLB/NFL game may block personal-interest mode, but not every game has established terrestrial carriage in San Francisco.
Inherited token checks can match unrelated parts of a page; snapshot matches are historical evidence, not live re-verification. Link and schema tests only validate structure.
